AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

2. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Powered Agricultural Implements? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Powered Agricultural Implements.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Powered Agricultural Implements.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Powered Agricultural Implements.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Powered Agricultural Implements.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Breeding? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Breeding.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Breeding.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Breeding.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forage Crops? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Forage Crops.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forage Crops.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forage Crops.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forage Crops.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Erosion Control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Erosion Control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Erosion Control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Erosion Control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Erosion Control.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agri- business Accounts? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agri- business Accounts.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agri- business Accounts.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agri- business Accounts.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Agri- business Accounts.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Cropping? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Cropping.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Cropping.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Cropping.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Cropping.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Disease control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Disease control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Disease control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Disease control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Disease control.

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Nutrition.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Nutrition.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Nutrition.

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

16. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.

18. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Biotechnology? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Biotechnology.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Biotechnology.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Biotechnology.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Biotechnology.

20. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Urban and peri-urban Agriculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Disease Control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Disease Control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Disease Control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Disease Control.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Business and Career Opportunities in Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Soil Erosion Control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Ornamental Cropping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Protection: Disease control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Forage Crops and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Nutrition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Breeding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Disease Control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
